problem.title: Authentication Error on Articles Settings Page
problem.description: The /settings/articles page shows a 401 Unauthorized error in the console when accessing /api/auth/me endpoint. Buttons on the page are not responding to clicks, preventing the admin user from creating or editing articles.

root_cause.summary: Redundant client-side authentication check in AuthGuard component

finding.issue: The AuthGuard component calls authStore.checkAuth() even when the user is already authenticated from SSR data, causing a redundant API call that fails with 401.

When $isAuthenticated is true (from localStorage), the component tries to verify with the server, but this verification fails because the session validation on client-side uses different headers than the SSR context.

finding.observation: The articles page itself does not have any authentication-related issues. The buttons are likely not working because the auth store is in an error state due to the failed checkAuth() call.

impact.affected_features: - Articles management page (/settings/articles) - All CRUD operations on articles - User experience for administrators
impact.symptoms: - 401 error in console on page load - Buttons not responding to clicks - Forms not opening when buttons are clicked - Page appears to load but is non-functional

steps.step: Modify AuthGuard.svelte to trust SSR authentication data and avoid redundant checkAuth() calls
Only call checkAuth() when there's no SSR data and no stored authentication
Ensure the auth store properly handles SSR data without additional verification

historical_context.reference: Similar issue was previously fixed in v3.5.1 as mentioned in CLAUDE.md: "Articles page 401 authentication error: RESOLVED - Fixed redundant client-side auth checks"
historical_context.note: The issue has resurfaced or was not completely fixed, indicating the need for a more comprehensive solution
